drafts.reply: The 5 USDT first trade credit does not change the zero-sum nature of later prediction market positions.
An internal market that beats experts for 10 years still gets closed because being outperformed is a bigger institutional risk than being wrong.
Breakpoint sponsorship leaves unchanged the reliance of dollar tokens on a handful of issuers and their freeze authority.
Prediction market payouts still depend on a resolver remaining solvent and honest. That operational risk is not present in the same form on a perp with an index feed.
Trust-to-ETF conversions typically collapse the NAV discount that closed-end products carry, which would change how Litecoin exposure is priced for institutions even if trading volume stays modest.
Prediction markets covering the 9 Europa League matches typically reprice more slowly than Premier League games because capital is split across more concurrent fixtures.
Liability for agent-driven transfers still sits with the humans who funded the wallets. historically unsupervised trading bots produced runaway losses without human overrides.
Dedicated AI compute still depends on grid capacity that customer contracts usually leave unaddressed.
Resolution rules on combo markets can create basis risk that single-event positions do not carry.
A 10,000 free mint does not confer legal title to any tokenized AI stocks until custody and securities registration are disclosed.
Investor reporting still treats agents as software spend not labor so the culture conversation will not fix how round sizes get justified.
A $1.57 billion inflow over 19 sessions can reverse when authorized participants reduce inventory after creations, which is a plumbing effect rather than a shift in Ethereum demand.
Prediction markets all time PNL omits the cost of capital tied up in events that take months to resolve.
Existing tokens already trading will still face Howey scrutiny regardless of any new fundraising safe harbor proposal.
Tribal IGRA coverage of Kalshi sports contracts would place one product under both CFTC event contract rules and tribal gaming commissions, a dual track state sportsbooks never faced.
